verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party "Filters & Rules" help article, and a community user refers to migrating their filters and rules, so Fastmail does offer a rule system that acts on incoming mail. However, the pack contains only the article title, so the triggers, conditions and actions are not described. JMAP push via EventSource/WebPush is a developer building block, not user-defined rules, and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented trigger/condition/action detail, events beyond incoming mail, programmatic or AI-driven rule management, hands-on corroboration of rule behavior.
